# surfaces

PTY bridge, xterm pane, the ephemeral shell surface, sizing, one live client per target.

- Spec: `docs/features/surfaces/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/surfaces/contract.md`

## Files

```
go: internal/server/terminal*.go
go: internal/server/shells*.go
go: internal/server/plainshell_test.go
go: internal/server/settings_shell_test.go
go: internal/termbridge/**
go: internal/tmux/**
web: web/src/features/surfaces.ts
web: web/src/terminal/**
e2e: web/e2e/terminal.spec.ts
e2e: web/e2e/shell.spec.ts
e2e: web/e2e/plain-shell.spec.ts
e2e: web/e2e/helpers/terminal.ts
e2e: web/e2e/helpers/shell.ts
```

## Protocol

- `terminal.ws` — WebSocket `/ws/terminal/{id}` — the PTY bridge
- `terminal.shell-ws` — WebSocket `/ws/shell/{id}` — the shell PTY bridge
- `sessions.shell` — `POST /api/sessions/{id}/shell`
